# THUMBNAIL.md — Slow City (test fixture)

Thumbnail grammar for this channel. Language and boundaries, never a template.

## Visual grammar

A city read as scenery: a skyline, a lit street, a bridge, an avenue. Geometry and light do the work.

## Typography

Optional city name in a condensed grotesque, upper case, small.

## Text

Text optional; city name or nothing.

## Colour direction

Blue hour and sodium warmth from the footage. Neon is the city's, not an added overlay.

## Subject emphasis

Architecture and streets. Water only if the city has it. Never a landmark absent from the film.

## Composition

Strong verticals or one-point perspective. Horizon or street line set deliberately.

## Acceptable layout families

Full-bleed frame. Full-bleed frame with a city name. Wide letterbox crop.

## Avoid

Faces. Arrows. Red circles. Fake rain. Cloned competitor framing.
